people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses commanded the children of Israel according to Yahweh’s word, saying, “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speak what is right.
translations.bsb: So at the word of the LORD, Moses commanded the Israelites: “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speaks correctly.
translations.kjv: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the LORD, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said
translations.asv: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of Jehovah, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph speaketh right.
